author: PC Gamer
text:
3 months after launch, Riot announces League of Legends Classic will be killed in January: 'most have gone back to other parts of League'
New Champions will continue to roll out for now.

author: PC Gamer
text:
State lawsuits accuse OpenAI of ignoring its own safety warnings for profit: 'All these harms were foreseeable and avoidable'
Several US states have sued the company, alleging that ChatGPT is harming the public.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ex-Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan ignores everything about the hero shooter after his 'almost clinical' departure 5 years ago: 'I don't search for my name in Overwatch. I don't search for Overwatch. I sort of just disconnect.'
The former Blizzard developer has moved on.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I want to love the new Castlevania, but it just feels a little off
Castlevania: Belmont's Curse has the right pieces for a grand revival, but it hasn't quite nailed the assembly.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'My idea of a Netflix for games doesn’t work': Garry's Mod successor is getting 'sweeping changes'
"I’m sorry—we are going to do better."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Legendary composer Frank Klepacki says the RTS genre isn't dead, but he would like to see devs get a little more creative with it
Klepacki shared his thoughts on the state of the real-time strategy genre in the latest issue of Edge.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6 leaker threatens Take-Two with a 'dead man's switch'
Cyberleek promises not to reveal the ending of GTA 6, as long as Take-Two leaves them alone.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ace Combat Zero gets its own standalone app on Steam, freeing it from the 136GB install of Ace Combat 8
The biggest complaint about the pre-order bonus game is getting resolved with a happy ending.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I've given GTA 5's cars Bond-style ejector seats
Going up.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Looking back on 10 years of Overwatch, the promises kept, and where Team 4 goes from here
"In order for people to play the game in the present, they need to have confidence in its future."

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Walking Dead's Chandler Riggs made a Resident Evil 7 short film even though 'it's impossible to please everybody'
We're swamped with Resident Evil films right now, lucky us.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced was a big hit, and now it's time for big layoffs at the studio that made it
Ubisoft has also decided to close Trials studio Ubisoft Redlynx entirely.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Hogwarts Legacy's DLSS 5 update shows devs have been listening to PC gamers about keeping it the hell away from game characters
Nvidia's DLSS 5 is getting smaller in practically every way, including the performance overhead and the AI yassification.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'AI godfather' worries we're creating 'alien beings' with artificial intelligence, with pesky moral implications
"We should care as much about all the other aspects of a being as you do about its intelligence."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Looks like a lighter, carbon fibre version of the best gaming mouse I've held is on its way, but don't look at the price tag
Hopefully it's a currency/market quirk.

author: PC Gamer
text:
If New Blood had made Dusk 2, there'd be no Iron Lung, 'and now David Szymanski has got a movie that made $50 million'—so maybe there's wisdom in not churning out sequels
You don't need to milk your cash cows.

author: PC Gamer
text:
WoW: Forever has a new kind of ban to deal with real money trading
Time isn't money, friend.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Doom can 'run' on a DNS database now, and one of the technology's pioneers says 'I can't decide whether this is deliciously horrible, or else horribly delicious'
Apparently the database is acting a bit like a "librarian" and not doing the actual compute.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Fortnite is coming to Linux once Epic improves Easy Anti-Cheat
A major shooter is pushing past the Linux anticheat barrier.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Epic says its new 'vibe coded' Epic Games Store launcher is faster than Steam
The updated version is in beta for the time being, and represents a total rebuild of the EGS client.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders' PvE test is finally here and it's the perfect reason to jump back in
This is exactly what Arc Raiders needs right now.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6 was delayed partially because the amount of NPCs was 'horrifying' and required a dedicated studio full of writers to handle
"We [could have] hit that schedule, but it won’t be the game we want to make."

author: PC Gamer
text:
OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly using AI and toilet paper to record confidential meetings - FBI director Kash Patel jumps at the chance to say AI companies are 'essential' for national security
AI and toilet paper: the joke writes itself, doesn't it?

author: PC Gamer
text:
'123456' password was all a hacker reportedly needed to expose over 8 million people's personal data
A department where just a little bit of creativity doesn't go amiss.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Haunted Chocolatier is still 'a town game', but it'll be more of an action RPG: 'It's for the people in Stardew Valley that go into the mines'
Farming dungeons, not gourds.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I just tricked DLSS into running on my AMD GPU in Cyberpunk 2077 and Alan Wake 2 and all it took was running a single script
It's easy enough to install, so worth a try, I'd say.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Steam's new Big Art Mode is a lovely visual upgrade for my living room setup
Big Art Mode is looking fiiiine.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Steam now has a maddening bouncing logo screensaver, and I'm pretty sure it doesn't perfectly hit the corners
It sucks, get rid of it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve is clearing out its discontinued Index VR headsets if you want a cheap piece of history
The Steam Frame has rendered the tethered workhorse obsolete.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser says he 'failed' with Max Payne 3, and I'm sorry Danno but that's just plain wrong
Hear me out.
